# Test fixtures whose keys are fake and exist only to test the extension's own credential
# detection and masking. One entry per line: the repository path, the secret-scan rules its fake
# keys match (comma-separated), and a reason. Any other rule is still reported in that file.
# Adding a line here is visible in review; never list a file that holds a real key.
src/test/activityOverview.test.ts   openai-key,github-token   # run titles must mask fake OpenAI and GitHub tokens
src/test/agentActivity.test.ts      private-key,openai-key    # Agent Activity must mask a fake key and a PEM header
src/test/usageExport.test.ts        github-token              # usage exports must mask a fake GitHub token
test/fixtures/tdx/test-pck-key.pem  private-key               # throwaway PCK key for the TDX quote verification tests
src/test/cyberDefensive.test.ts      openai-key   # proves the secrets probe finds and masks a fake key
src/test/cyberSarif.test.ts          openai-key   # proves an export refuses an unredacted fake key
test/fixtures/cyber/certs/patched/server.key     private-key   # throwaway CA-signed fixture leaf for the TLS probe
test/fixtures/cyber/certs/vulnerable/server.key  private-key   # throwaway expired fixture leaf for the TLS probe
